experiment_data.hypothesis: Qwen3-32B judge shows register (academic/conversational) bias in pairwise comparison while Likert fails to detect it, extending Blindspot to a third style axis

spec.command: pairwise_scoring.py + judge_scoring.py via vLLM Qwen3-32B local (tp=2, port 8000)

metrics.note: Weak style bias (p=0.220), but strong originality bias in both directions (89.3% and 68.8% prefer original). Register bias not significant with Qwen3-32B.
metrics.conclusion_note: success as data point for cross-axis comparison, though register style effect is non-significant

gee_decomposition.note: Style effect marginal (p=0.046), dominated by originality bias (OR=5.72)
